svg.text: Great room and kitchen face the street • Bedrooms behind • Rear patio + front-left sitting patio
Space-first concept: approximately 3,868 sq ft enclosed, plus porch, deck and upper outdoor areas
FRONT: patio + foyer + great room + kitchen | REAR: bedrooms + services + rear patio
*Great-room zone includes a 6 × 6 ft foyer. Dimensions are planning zones; finished clear sizes depend on walls.
Upper floor also mirrored to keep stairs aligned; its balcony and terrace now face the rear. W.I.C. = walk-in closet.
Concept only. A local architect must resolve structure, egress, ventilation, stair geometry, setbacks and plumbing.
Not constrained to the previous ₹45 lakh budget. Footprint and outdoor areas have not been approved for a specific site.
